shots.beat: Close on the conductor's punch stopping over a trembling hand as the car lights flicker, and his eyes lock onto Tomas's face as he speaks.

line.speaker: c1
line.text: This ticket is for yesterday's train.

shots.beat: Tomas swallows and answers in a whisper while the conductor leans in and slowly taps the stamped date with the punch.

line.speaker: c2
line.text: I was on that train. I never got off.

shots.beat: Tomas slowly turns his head to the dark window, and the glass shows only the conductor's reflection behind an empty seat, his reflected eyes staring straight at Tomas.
